requirement: The sign-in gate's chat bubble stays hidden for a seat when the state answer fails, errors or does not say chatEnabled

oracle.ref: PR #1094 (fix); fix evidence: Found 09/10/2026 while closing the avatar debt of PR #1082: chat.tsx set the bubble 'on' in its catch and on !res.ok.
oracle.invariant: S1: 500 answer, thrown fetch, and an OK answer without chatEnabled render no bubble and fetch no messages; chatEnabled true shows it.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
